SELECT
    COUNT("customer_id") AS "Number of Customer Records",
    SUM("purchase_amount_usd") AS "Total Purchase Amount USD"
FROM "dataset"

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG("purchase_amount_usd"), 2) AS "Average Purchase Amount USD",
    MIN("purchase_amount_usd") AS "Minimum Purchase Amount USD",
    MAX("purchase_amount_usd") AS "Maximum Purchase Amount USD"
FROM "dataset"

SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG("age"), 2) AS "Average Age",
    ROUND(AVG("previous_purchases"), 2) AS "Average Previous Purchases"
FROM "dataset"

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG("review_rating"), 2) AS "Average Review Rating",
    MIN("review_rating") AS "Minimum Review Rating",
    MAX("review_rating") AS "Maximum Review Rating",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "review_rating" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Missing Review Ratings Count"
FROM "dataset"

SELECT
    "category",
    COUNT("customer_id") AS "record count",
    SUM("purchase_amount_usd") AS "total purchase amount",
    ROUND(AVG("purchase_amount_usd"), 2) AS "average purchase amount"
FROM "dataset"
GROUP BY "category"

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN "age" BETWEEN 18 AND 29 THEN '18-29'
        WHEN "age" BETWEEN 30 AND 44 THEN '30-44'
        WHEN "age" BETWEEN 45 AND 59 THEN '45-59'
        WHEN "age" BETWEEN 60 AND 70 THEN '60-70'
    END AS "age_band",
    COUNT(*) AS "record_count",
    ROUND(AVG("purchase_amount_usd"), 2) AS "average_purchase_amount"
FROM "dataset"
WHERE "age" BETWEEN 18 AND 70
GROUP BY "age_band"
ORDER BY "age_band"

SELECT
    "gender",
    COUNT(*) AS "record_count",
    SUM("purchase_amount_usd") AS "total_purchase_amount",
    ROUND(AVG("previous_purchases"), 2) AS "average_previous_purchases"
FROM "dataset"
GROUP BY "gender"

SELECT
    "season",
    COUNT(*) AS "record_count",
    SUM("purchase_amount_usd") AS "total_purchase_amount"
FROM "dataset"
GROUP BY "season"

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS "record_count",
    ROUND(AVG("purchase_amount_usd"), 2) AS "average_purchase_amount"
FROM "dataset"
WHERE "gender" = 'Female'
  AND "age" >= 50
  AND "purchase_amount_usd" >= 80

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS "Record Count",
    SUM("purchase_amount_usd") AS "Total Purchase Amount"
FROM "dataset"
WHERE "gender" = 'Male'
  AND "subscription_status" = 'Yes'
  AND "previous_purchases" >= 25

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS "Record Count",
    ROUND(AVG("purchase_amount_usd"), 2) AS "Average Purchase Amount"
FROM "dataset"
WHERE "review_rating" IS NULL

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS "record_count",
    ROUND(AVG("purchase_amount_usd"), 2) AS "average_purchase_amount"
FROM "dataset"
WHERE "subscription_status" = 'No'
  AND "review_rating" >= 4.5
  AND "discount_applied" = 'No'

SELECT
    "category",
    SUM("purchase_amount_usd") AS "total_purchase_amount",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("purchase_amount_usd") DESC, "category" ASC) AS "rank"
FROM "dataset"
GROUP BY "category"
ORDER BY "total_purchase_amount" DESC, "category" ASC

SELECT
    "category",
    "customer_id",
    "age",
    "gender",
    "item_purchased",
    "purchase_amount_usd",
    "location",
    "size",
    "color",
    "season",
    "review_rating",
    "subscription_status",
    "shipping_type",
    "discount_applied",
    "promo_code_used",
    "previous_purchases",
    "payment_method",
    "frequency_of_purchases"
FROM (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY "category"
            ORDER BY "purchase_amount_usd" DESC, "customer_id" ASC
        ) as rn
    FROM "dataset"
) sub
WHERE rn = 1

SELECT "customer_id", "age", "gender", "item_purchased", "category", "purchase_amount_usd", "location", "size", "color", "season", "review_rating", "subscription_status", "shipping_type", "discount_applied", "promo_code_used", "previous_purchases", "payment_method", "frequency_of_purchases"
FROM (
    SELECT *,
           AVG("purchase_amount_usd") OVER (PARTITION BY "category") AS "cat_avg"
    FROM "dataset"
)
WHERE "purchase_amount_usd" > "cat_avg"
ORDER BY "category", "customer_id"
LIMIT 20

SELECT
    "location",
    SUM("purchase_amount_usd") AS "total_purchase_amount",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("purchase_amount_usd") DESC, "location" ASC) AS "rank"
FROM "dataset"
GROUP BY "location"
ORDER BY "total_purchase_amount" DESC, "location" ASC
